A stack of glass drums with six Region Blades. Each run splits 4,000 L of Entanglement Medium into six §9Entangled Region§r condensates, 1,000 L each (Hyperspace, Subspace, Forward Time, Reverse Time, Visible Mass, Dark Mass), and pushes them into a Bose-Einstein Condensate network: outside reality. 120 s at MAX.
- Each region needs its own anchor in its own socket: I Space 1,440 L, II SpaceTime 1,440 L, III Time 1,440 L, IV Eternity 144 L, V Superdense Ergomatter 500 L, VI §9Attractor Dark Matter 288 L§r. A region without its anchor is lost.
- The mass axis splits the way the real universe does: visible matter against dark matter.
- Give the Reality machines their own BEC network: six extra condensates would clog every other Condensate Assembler. The machine waits, never voids, when the network is full.
- Its portal takes 6 GRB Receptor Ports: faster with a strong quasar link, paused with a weak one, × 1 with none (see §cRiding the Rift§r).
- The controller: Condensate Assembler, MAX, with 36,864 L Entangled Attractor Dark Matter.
